verdict.rationale: Admin SDK Reports API (google-workspace-docs-6, -24) provides audit/usage logs including login and admin activity events queryable via API, and Cloud Identity API supports identity resource management, giving a structured, API-accessible identity log. However, evidence does not show native streaming/push integration to SIEM tools (e.g., no mention of Pub/Sub export, log sink, or SIEM connector), and community evidence highlights gaps in visibility into which policy/event caused an action (google-workspace-comm-1, google-workspace-comm-3), undermining full observability confidence. missing for 10: native SIEM streaming/export mechanism (e.g. Pub/Sub push, BigQuery export documentation), independent confirmation of completeness/granularity of identity event logs, and resolution of admin-reported gaps in event traceability.
